rimRadius.description: Rim ring radius (center of the tube)

floorY.description: Ball center height when resting on the floor

fullPowerSwipe.description: Swipe length in px for maximum power

lateralFactor.description: Sideways aim offset (m) per pixel of sideways drag

resetDelay.description: Seconds after the first floor contact before respawn

backboardZ.description: Z of the backboard front face

visual.title: Visual (mesh child)
visual.description: Rotated for spin so lights on the root stay fixed

sideSpinFactor.description: Side spin (deg/s) per pixel of sideways drag

netDrag.description: Horizontal speed kept when the ball drops through the net

minBounceSpeed.description: Below this vertical speed the ball stops bouncing and rolls

floorFriction.description: Horizontal speed kept at each floor bounce

perfectPower.description: Swipe power (0-1) that lands exactly in the rim center

depthFactor.description: Depth aim error (m) per unit of power away from perfectPower (0 = always deep enough)

spawnArc.description: Half-amplitude of the spawn arc around the hoop (degrees)

arcHeight.description: Apex height above the rim: sets the bell shape of the shot

shotSpeed.description: Time multiplier: >1 = same arc, faster ball; <1 = slower

netDepth.description: Net length below the rim (m): zone where the net guides the ball

netPull.description: How strongly the net centers the ball while it drops through (1/s)

airDrag.description: In-flight slowdown (1/s): high initial burst that progressively slows toward the apex

trailOpacity.description: Trail opacity behind the ball (0 = disabled, 1 = opaque)

trailWidth.description: Initial trail width behind the ball (m)

followAmount.description: How far the rig follows the ball (0-1)

lookAmount.description: How much the view turns toward the ball (0 = fixed view, 1 = centered on the ball)

heightScale.description: Vertical scale of the original node layout

dragRange.description: Distance beyond the ball surface where ropes get dragged

dragAmount.description: Share of the ball velocity transferred to nearby ropes

ropeMargin.description: Extra gap kept between the ball surface and the ropes so they never show through the ball

iterations.description: Constraint passes per step (more = the ball opens the net more cleanly)
